content:
[L] high | bottom edge of window | "By agent" card (Grace Hopper row) and "By team" card (Tier 2 row) are clipped mid-row at the window bottom, cutting content off entirely.
[L] high | "Issue radar" card | the explanatory caption "every channel is listed..." actually belongs to By channel card — check: the caption "every channel is listed — the Channel filter scopes the other cards, not this one" runs to the very right edge of the By channel card, nearly touching the card border.
[S] high | By channel card | the explanatory sentence is full-width micro-text jammed between the card title and the rows, making the card interior cramped compared to the airy "By mailbox" card.
[S] med | top-left header | "Dashboard" title sits flush against the window edge with ~8px inset, while the filter bar and cards use a visibly larger inset — inconsistent page margins.
[S] med | chart card | axis labels "2025-12-16" and "2026-01-15" and the "First 2 → Latest: 2" annotation touch the plot border with no padding, nearly colliding with the plotted line endpoints.
[S] med | KPI grid | first row of stat cards is taller-titled ("New", "Active"...) while row values use two different number sizes/weights; the two KPI rows have inconsistent internal alignment of value baselines.
[S] low | filter bar | gap between "Mailboxes" label and its "All" pill is tighter than the gap between "Channel" and its pill, breaking pairing rhythm.
[H] high | entire screen | no typographic hierarchy: card titles, row labels, captions, and filter labels are all near-identical small gray sans-serif; nothing reads as a heading vs. body.
[H] med | subtitle under Dashboard | "Local metrics - sources labeled Help Scout / local / AI-derived everywhere" is developer-debug jargon rendered as a product subtitle in tiny gray text.
[H] med | stat cards | label ("Replies sent") and value ("1") are the same visual weight family; value is large but labels offer no emphasis, so cards read as undifferentiated.
[C] med | Issue radar card | a large mostly-empty card containing only a centered icon and two lines of text — a dead zone occupying ~30% of the middle-right area while bottom-row cards are clipped for space.
[C] med | bottom row | "By mailbox"/"By tag" row and "By agent"/"By team" row have mismatched heights, and the right column ends after "By channel" leaving an empty hole beneath it.
[C] low | chart card | only 4 data points rendered as a giant smooth area chart — the visualization is disproportionate to the data density.
[C] low | KPI cards | twelve near-identical white cards of equal weight create uniform visual noise with no prioritized metric.

VERDICT: unprofessional — clipped bottom cards, debug-jargon copy, flat hierarchy, and unbalanced empty regions make this read as a work-in-progress debug dashboard, not shippable product.
